evidence.summary: Claude Codeはread-only既定、fail-closed matching、curl/wget非自動許可、WebFetchの隔離context、command injection detection、-pではtrust verification無効を明記（2026-08-15閲覧）
Codexはworkspace-write既定・network既定off、.git/.codex/.agents保護、CIは--sandbox read-only --ask-for-approval never、web検索はcached既定でinjection露出を下げる
